name: yf_shares_outstanding
description:
Shares outstanding over time (about the last 18 months) for one ticker from Yahoo Finance (yfinance get_shares_full).
Returns: {symbol, data_points (all rows), truncated, shares: the most recent limit rows, oldest first, each {index (date-time), 0 (share count)}}.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (Yahoo ticker, e.g. AAPL, BRK-B, 7203.T); limit (rows, 1-1000; default 100).
Current count only: yf_fast_info; float and short interest: openbb_equity_share_statistics.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "limit": 20}
